parameters.query: INSERT INTO ops_incidents (fingerprint, source, workflow_name, failed_node, severity, category, summary, fix_note, classifier_ok, received_at) SELECT r->>'fingerprint', r->>'source', r->>'workflow_name', r->>'failed_node', r->>'severity', r->>'category', r->>'summary', r->>'fix_note', (r->>'classifier_ok')::boolean, (r->>'received_at')::timestamptz FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS r) AS input RETURNING id;
